text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was quite exhausting. What
a
workout.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru, you're quite light on your
feet. You
practically flew right past me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! I sped up and finished before
you,
didn't I? I felt like I was rolling
nothing but sixes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Actually, maybe I rolled a ten? Or even
a twenty?
Whatever it was, my rolls
were, well, on a roll! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Who knew... luck could make you this
strong?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Luck? Strong?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, I get it! I guess that saying is correct after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What saying?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You know! The Kikuka Sho is won by the

strongest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's gotta mean it's won by the
Umamusume
with the strongest luck!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah, is that what it means?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what Matikanefukukitaru says,
it's
obvious she didn't win because of
just luck.
Mejiro Bright did her best out
there, but it wasn't
enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I may have lost today, but I still
believe
I've managed to carve the Mejiro
name into the
track at Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Long-distance races are such a joy.
They're quite
different from
medium-lengths. I'm excited to try

another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Mejiro Bright proved she can
manage a
3,000-meter race. We reflect
on her run and
discuss her future.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it has a different kind of charm.
Yeah, it's fun in a different way, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She could continue to focus on
long-distance or
improve her craft by
returning to medium.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I want what the Mejiro family wants.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So I will not waver. The Mejiro path
leads next to
the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess Mejiro Bright sees the path
ahead of her
clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First was the Kikuka Sho, and now the
spring
Tenno Sho... but does it really
lead to a top
senior-year G1
long-distance race?

If you cannot make up your mind quite
yet, why
don't you perform a test first?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, McQueen, Ryan! You're both here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan and I have been discussing where
we think
your true affinity lies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, there is an upcoming race
ideal for
assessing your potential as a
stayer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An ideal race? She must be talking
about...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. At 3,600 meters, it is the
longest race
in the country. Further, it is
a mixed G2 race that
includes senior
year Umamusume. If you can
secure a
victory there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There will be no reason to doubt your
abilities as
a stayer. Right, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think it's better not to ignore
Bright's
potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, what do you say to that idea,
Trainer? Do
you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. It's quiiite a long one, right?
I'm
excited just thinking about it.
choice_data_list: ...All right. Let's go with the Stayers Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Stayers Stakes—with its
unparalleled length,
it's a clear standout
of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think there we'll find our answer to the
mystery
of Mejiro Bright's true talents.
